invariant.portable_principle: A static Go dormant report establishes only that an unexported package-level function or function-valued variable has no go/types-resolved use in the selected active-build package; it never establishes safe deletion or runtime unreachability.
invariant.go_mechanism: One family-local batched helper combines go list active-package facts with go/parser, go/types, and go/importer use resolution.
explicit_non_goals: Interface, reflection, //go:linkname, generated-registration, plugin, cgo, assembly, external, or runtime reachability
A shared go list/go types platform

syntax: Unexported package-level variables whose Go type has a function signature
semantic_project: go list -deps -export selects active package files and export data
go/types resolves same-package object uses across active source files
go/importer consumes host-generated export data for imports
runtime: Reflection, linker directives, generated registration, plugins, cgo, and assembly remain explicit uncertainty

tooling.selected: Family-local detect_go_dormant.py plus one batched detect_go_dormant.go helper using only Go stdlib/toolchain facts.

rejected_alternatives.lexical_grep: Cannot distinguish same-name strings, shadows, or resolved package uses.
rejected_alternatives.go_packages: Adds a non-stdlib dependency without a required v1 fact.
rejected_alternatives.shared_project_platform: No accepted second consumer has an identical result schema, closure, or review-only contract.

tooling.closure_mode: Copied selected find-dormant root; no toolkit venv, repository helper, sibling skill, network, or shared Go runtime dependency.
preflight_and_failure_codes: Exit 2 for missing/old Go, malformed Go, invalid/symlink target, or unsafe report path.
Final partial report for build-constrained, cgo, package, or type facts unavailable from the active package model.

must_fire: Exact matching string name as uncertain
must_not_fire: Directly used private function and function-valued variable
outcome_contract.source_boundary: Read-only; fixture source hashes are unchanged before and after the final artifact run.

known_false_positives: A zero-use private symbol may remain reachable by reflection, linker directives, generated registration, plugin loading, cgo, assembly, or external/runtime behavior.
known_false_negatives: Methods, types, excluded/generated/vendor/test sources, constrained files, cgo packages, and unavailable type/package facts intentionally produce no candidate.
legitimate_similar_shapes: Direct handler registration is a resolved identifier use and remains clean.
A string-addressed name stays uncertain, not review_required.
Generated references create an explicit runtime uncertainty, not candidate proof.

reuse_decision.shared_candidate: go list active-package selection plus go/types object-use facts
evidence: find-dormant needs a no-deletion review queue, dynamic uncertainty, and final Markdown/JSON report.
No second G2 consumer has demonstrated an identical installed closure and result contract.

checks: Host go test ./... before and after scan
Malformed/missing/old Go and partial build-package boundaries

next_decision.recommendation: Retain Go v1 as a bounded human-review aid and keep its Go helper family-local.
